'''''Mal'ary'ush''''' was [[Honoghran]] for ''daughter of the savior.'' The ''savior'' in question was [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], whom the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] people revered. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] earlier, a [[Gahenna|starship]] carrying noxious chemicals [[Battle of Honoghr/Legends|crashed]] on [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] and threatened to destroy the entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They believed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent Vader to the planet to help them, but in reality Palpatine was responsible for the devastation of Honoghr, as a way to bend their allegiance to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

The ''daughter'' was [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who years later would find herself at the mercy of the Noghri people in the Republic's [[Thrawn campaign|battle]] against their new master, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. However, one Noghri, [[Khabarakh]], through the use of the sense of smell inherent to the Noghri&mdash;acute enough to smell even one's bloodline&mdash;discovered she was the daughter of Vader and pledged to help her escape Imperial custody. Later, Leia would [[Mission to Honoghr|reveal]] the treachery of Palpatine to the Noghri, which emboldened them to finally [[Noghri revolution|break]] their allegiance to the Galactic Empire.
